summary_md: **ben ([@benbye](https://x.com/benbye/status/2115488344050192584))** trained **NanoDreamer**, a 750K-parameter Dreamer-inspired world-model agent on an M5 Pro that learns game dynamics and trains an actor-critic in latent imagination; the write-up and a self-thread explain the setup.

referenced_urls.title: NanoDreamer: Learning to Act Through Imagination

relevance: A tiny, local, readable world-model agent: a good entry point to imagination-based agents.
